We have evaluation metrics and cross-validation results. Need to create JSON file with keys test_set_evaluation and cross_validation_results. test_set_evaluation must contain mae, rmse, r2, and feature_importance. From evaluation output we have mae, rmse, r2, feature_importance dict. Use those.

cross_validation_results must contain r2_mean and r2_std.

Create JSON file at workspace path: /Users/n0w0f/git/n0w0f_2026/corral_fixes/corral/WORKDIR/7/0_evaluate_model_performance_trial_8/model_evaluation_results.json

Write file.
